what: Study 2: visibility of the illness movers and of the ill resident in the last-seen cell's own looks

definitions.new room: a room (receptacle room) the mover truly occupies at some moment on days 14-23 and never on days 1-13, from the bank's truth rows; ON_PERSON and out-of-house excluded
definitions.seen in new room by day d: at least one sighting of the mover in one of its new rooms at a time from the start of day 14 to the end of day d
definitions.out of routine (resident): a sighting of the ill resident on days 14..d with no sighting of them on days 1-13 in the same room within one hour of the same time of day
